independent_review.scope: Independent semantic and part-of-speech review of all frozen round3 Oxford proposals (AL 87, MZ 135). ETS withdrawn borderline participle retained only as an audit record.
notes: 逐条核对英文是否为完整自然句、中文义项与语境是否对应；疑点交叉查看公开词典缓存的释义。

retail price 原例句在 Oxford American 的 retail noun 条目内，名词作定语表示零售，保留。

policy: Only traceable original ETS/Oxford sentences; specific POS and meaning reviewed, no authored English, Chinese translations are our own. Empty, incomplete, inaccessible, unmatched and quotation-budget-limited entries remain null. No learning events or mastery claims are created.
